cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：光滑的；顺利的

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：疼痛的
cards.example_en: My sore throat made it hard to sing in the choir.
cards.example_zh: 我嗓子疼，很难在合唱团里唱歌。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：南方的
cards.example_en: Southern cities stay warm even in late December.
cards.example_zh: 南方的城市即使到十二月下旬也很暖和。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：说；讲话
cards.example_en: Guides speak more slowly so the visitors understand.
cards.example_zh: 导游说得更慢一些，好让参观的人听懂。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Our summary of the chapter filled half a page.
cards.example_zh: 我们对这一章写的摘要占了半页纸。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: My uncle likes to talk with neighbours over the fence.
cards.example_zh: 我叔叔喜欢隔着篱笆和邻居谈话。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Her serving technique improved after weeks of practice.
cards.example_zh: 练了几个星期之后，她的发球手法进步了。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: The office telephone rang all through lunch break.
cards.example_zh: 办公室的电话响了整整一个午休。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: I will tell the driver where I need to get off.
cards.example_zh: 我会告诉司机我要在哪里下车。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Copy the text from the board into your notebook.
cards.example_zh: 把黑板上的文本抄到你的笔记本里。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Can you translate this menu so my aunt can order?
cards.example_zh: 你能翻译这份菜单，好让我阿姨点菜吗？

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: No vehicle may enter the park during the festival.
cards.example_zh: 节日期间，任何车辆都不得进入公园。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Lily filmed a short video of the school play.
cards.example_zh: 莉莉给学校话剧拍了一段短视频。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.explain_zh: 中考/CEFR 常用词：威尔士
cards.example_en: My pen friend lives in Wales and writes in English.
cards.example_zh: 我的笔友住在威尔士，并且用英语写信。

cards.scene: 通讯媒体 · Communications and Media
cards.example_en: Students search the web for the club timetable.
cards.example_zh: 学生们在网上查找社团的时间表。
